It can determine which location has the greatest amount of gold and can sense the direction to that site. If the gold is being moved, it knows the direction of the movement. actions.name: Multiattack

actions.name: Shield Bash

Some anvilwrought raptors are created expressly to be familiars. Such creatures have the following trait.

actions.name: Beak
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (2/Day)

traits.name: Magic Resistance

actions.name: Claws

A frightened creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to Aphemia's Discordant Song for the next 24 hours. Aphemia must take a bonus action on her subsequent turns to continue singing. She can stop singing at any time. The song ends if Aphemia is incapacitated or dies.

actions.name: Grave Calling Song
actions.desc: Aphemia intones a low, growling magical melody. Every undead within 300 feet of her must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or fall under her control until the song ends. Aphemia must take a bonus action on her subsequent turns to continue singing, and she can mentally command the undead under her control as part of the same bonus action. She can stop singing at any time. The song ends if Aphemia is incapacitated or dies.

sb.name: Arasta
sb.damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks
sb.senses: blindsight 60 ft., darkvision 120 ft., passive Perception 23

traits.name: Armor of Spiders (Mythic Trait; Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
traits.desc: If Arasta is reduced to 0 hit points, she doesn't die or fall unconscious. Instead, she regains 200 hit points. In addition, Arasta's children immediately swarm over her body to protect her, granting her 100 temporary hit points.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)

traits.name: Magic Resistance

traits.name: Spider Climb

traits.name: Web Walker

actions.name: Multiattack

If the damage reduces the target to 0 hit points, the target is stable but poisoned for 1 hour, even after regaining hit points, and is paralyzed while poisoned in this way.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +14 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (3d6 + 7) slashing damage.

actions.name: Web of Hair (Recharge 4–6)
actions.desc: Arasta unleashes her hair in the form of webbing that fills a 30-foot cube next to her. The web is difficult terrain, its area is lightly obscured, and it lasts for 1 minute. Any creature that moves into the web or that starts its turn there must make a DC 21 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the creature is restrained while in the web. A creature can use an action to make a DC 21 Strength check. On a success, it can free itself or a creature within 5 feet of it that is restrained by the web. This webbing is immune to all damage except magical fire. A 5-foot cube of the web is destroyed if it takes at least 20 fire damage from a spell or other magical source on a single turn.

legendary_actions.name: Claws

legendary_actions.name: Swarm (Costs 2 Actions)

traits.name: Mount

When it teleports, the archon appears astride the mount, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying. While mounted and not incapacitated, the archon can't be surprised, and both it and its mount have advantage on Dexterity saving throws. If the archon is reduced to 0 hit points while riding its mount, the mount is reduced to 0 hit points as well.

traits.name: Radiant Rebirth (Recharges after a Long Rest)
traits.desc: If the archon is reduced to 0 hit points, it regains 30 hit points and springs back to its feet with a burst of radiance. Each creature of the archon's choice within 30 feet of it must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw, or the creature takes 13 (3d8) radiant damage and is blinded until the start of the archon's turn.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc:

- **At Will:** [[Tools/Spells/Command|command]], [[Tools/Spells/Guiding Bolt|guiding bolt]], [[Tools/Spells/Spare The Dying|spare the dying]]
- **1/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Crusader'S Mantle|crusader's mantle]], [[Tools/Spells/Spirit Guardians|spirit guardians]]

legendary_actions.name: Attack

legendary_actions.name: Coordinated Assault (Costs 2 Actions)

A creature reduced to ash can't be revived by any means short of a [[Tools/Spells/Wish|wish]] spell.

traits.desc: The hoplite has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the hoplite's allies is within 5 feet of the hoplite and the ally isn't incapacitated.

traits.name: Spell Turning
traits.desc: The chimera has advantage on a saving throw against any spell that targets only the chimera (not an area). If the chimera's saving throw is successful and the spell is of 4th level or lower, the spell has no effect on the chimera and instead targets the caster.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The chimera makes three attacks: one with its claws, one with its head, and one with its tail. When its breath weapon is available, it can use the breath in place of its head or its claws.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) slashing damage.

actions.name: Head
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (1d12 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Tail
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Breath Weapon (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: The chimera exhales fire in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw, taking 32 (5d12) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

traits.name: Summon Water Weird (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
traits.desc: As a bonus action, the triton magically summons 1d4 water weirds. The summoned weirds appear in unoccupied spaces in water within 60 feet of the triton. The water weirds act immediately after the triton on the same initiative count and fight until they're destroyed. They disappear if the triton dies.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc:
The triton's spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 15, +7 to hit with spell attacks). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

- **At Will:** [[Tools/Spells/Ray Of Frost|ray of frost]] (see "Actions" below)
- **2/Day:** [[Tools/Spells/Cone Of Cold|cone of cold]]
- **1/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Fog Cloud|fog cloud]], [[Tools/Spells/Gust Of Wind|gust of wind]], [[Tools/Spells/Wind Wall|wind wall]]

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The triton makes two attacks using Wave Touch and casts [[Tools/Spells/Ray Of Frost|ray of frost]].

actions.name: Wave Touch
actions.desc: Melee Spell Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (4d10) cold damage.

actions.name: Ray of Frost (Cantrip)
actions.desc: Ranged Spell Attack: +7 to hit, range 60 ft., one creature. Hit: 13 (3d8) cold damage, and the target's speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of the triton's next turn.

reactions.name: Frigid Shield
reactions.desc: When a creature the triton can see targets the triton with an attack, the triton gains 10 temporary hit points. If the attack hits and reduces the temporary hit points to 0, each creature within 5 feet of the triton takes 9 (2d8) cold damage.

actions.name: Urchin-Spine Shortsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) poison damage. If the damage reduces a creature to 0 hit points, that creature is stable but poisoned for 1 hour, even after regaining hit points, and is paralyzed while poisoned in this way.

actions.name: Poisoned Spine
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, range 30/60 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) poison damage.

sb.name: Tromokratis
sb.damage_immunities: fire; bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.desc: Tromokratis can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Hearts of the Kraken (Mythic Trait; Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
traits.desc: When Tromokratis is reduced to 0 hit points, it doesn't die or fall unconscious. Instead, the damage creates cracks in its carapace, revealing its hearts. Tromokratis has four hearts: two on its chest, one on its back, and one at the base of its tail. A heart has an AC of 22 and 100 hit points. It is immune to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks, and it is immune to all conditions. If it is forced to make a saving throw, treat its ability scores as 10 (+0). If it finishes a short or long rest, the carapace heals, any destroyed hearts regenerate, and the hearts are covered again. Tromokratis dies when all the hearts are destroyed.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.desc: If Tromokratis fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.desc: Tromokratis's weapon attacks are magical.

traits.name: Siege Monster
traits.desc: Tromokratis deals double damage to objects and structures.

traits.name: Spell-Resistant Carapace
traits.desc: Tromokratis has advantage on saving throws against spells, and any creature that makes a spell attack against Tromokratis has disadvantage on the attack roll.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Tromokratis makes three attacks: one with its pincer, one with its tail, and one with its tentacle grasp.

actions.name: Pincer
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +18 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. Hit: 20 (3d6 + 10) bludgeoning damage, and if the target is a creature, it is grappled (escape DC 26). Until the grapple ends, the target is restrained, and Tromokratis can't use this attack on anyone else.

actions.name: Tail
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +18 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. Hit: 23 (3d8 + 10) bludgeoning damage, and if the target is a creature, it is knocked prone.

actions.name: Tentacle Grasp
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +18 to hit, reach 20 ft., one creature. Hit: 20 (3d6 + 10) bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 26). If the target doesn't escape by the end of its next turn, Tromokratis throws the target up to 60 feet in a straight line. The target lands prone and takes 21 (6d6) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +18 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 29 (3d12 + 10) piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature grappled by Tromokratis, that creature is swallowed, and the grapple ends. While swallowed, the creature is blinded and restrained, it has total cover against attacks and other effects outside Tromokratis, and it takes 42 (12d6) acid damage at the start of each of Tromokratis's turns. If Tromokratis takes 50 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, Tromokratis must succeed on a DC 20 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, which fall prone in a space within 10 feet of Tromokratis. If Tromokratis dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained by it and can escape from the corpse by using 15 feet of movement, exiting prone.

legendary_actions.name: Move
legendary_actions.desc: Tromokratis moves up to half its speed.

legendary_actions.name: Tail
legendary_actions.desc: Tromokratis makes one tail attack.

legendary_actions.name: Bite (Costs 3 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: Tromokratis makes one bite attack.

sb.legendary_description: Legendary action uses: 3. One can be taken immediately after another creature's turn, and all uses come back at the start of this creature's turn.

mythic_actions.name: Rampage
mythic_actions.desc: Tromokratis makes two attacks: one with its tail and one with its tentacle grasp.

mythic_actions.name: Coral Growth (Costs 2 Actions)
mythic_actions.desc: Each creature within 10 feet of Tromokratis must make a DC 25 Dexterity saving throw, taking 13 (3d8) slashing damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Until the start of its next turn, Tromokratis and its hearts gain a +2 bonus to AC.

sb.mythic_description: If Tromokratis's mythic trait is active, it can use the options below as legendary actions for 1 hour after using Hearts of the Kraken.

actions.name: Bite

actions.desc: The cerberus exhales a 15-foot cone of molten rock. Each creature in the cone must make a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw, taking 10 (3d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. On a failed save, a creature is also restrained by the hardening rock. A creature can make a DC 12 Strength (Athletics) check as an action, freeing itself or a creature within reach from the rock on a success. The rock has AC 17 and 10 hit points, and it is immune to fire, poison, and psychic damage.

traits.name: Keen Smell
traits.desc: The typhon has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.desc: The typhon regains 20 hit points at the start of its turn. If it takes radiant damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of its next turn. The typhon dies only if it starts its turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The typhon makes three attacks: one with its Flurry of Bites, one to constrict, and one with its maw.

actions.name: Flurry of Bites
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +12 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 35 (8d6 + 7) piercing damage.

actions.name: Constrict
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +12 to hit, reach 15 ft., one Large or smaller creature. Hit: 17 (3d6 + 7) bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 19). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained and takes 17 (3d6 + 7) bludgeoning damage at the start of each of its turns. The typhon can have up to two creatures constricted.

actions.name: Maw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +12 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 26 (3d12 + 7) piercing damage plus 19 (3d12) acid damage.
